color.intro: Pick a lovely picture and color it your way.
steps: Pick a theme (Animals, Vehicles…), then a subject, then the pose you like.
Pick a mode: "Paint by number" has a sample and numbers for each area; "Free coloring" lets you use any colors.
Pick a color and tap an area to fill it. Use Brush, Stickers or Glitter to add more.
Tap "Finish" to see your picture come to life, then download or print it.
color.tip: Unfinished pictures are saved automatically in History, so you can continue any time.

arena.intro: Color against up to 10 kids with fair, automatic scoring.
steps: Tap "Find a match" to play kids at your level, or "Create room" and send the code to friends.
When the match starts, everyone colors the same picture in Free mode before time runs out.
Tap "Submit" when you're done and wait for the others.
See your scores in 6 categories. The top 3 earn Rank points and Gacha points.
arena.tip: Stay inside the lines, choose harmonious colors and be unique to score high!

together.intro: 2–4 kids color one picture together and see each other's colors instantly.
steps: Tap "New room" and pick the picture to color together.
Send the room code to your friends. Only people with the code can join.
Color together. Each friend has their own colored pointer on the picture.
Tap "Save picture" to save it to everyone's History.
together.tip: Undo only removes your own last stroke, never a friend's.

gacha.intro: Use Gacha points to open rare picture cards and collect them.
steps: Place in the Arena top 3 to earn Gacha points.
Every 50 Gacha points = 1 card. Leftover points are kept.
Cards come in S, A, B and C. Each card is a rare picture you unlock to color.
Gift or swap cards with friends, up to 3 times a day.
gacha.tip: Opening cards never lowers your rank and never uses real money.

storybooks.intro: Turn your Free coloring pictures into your very own storybook.
steps: Tap "New storybook" and give it a title.
Pick finished Free coloring pictures as pages.
Arrange the pages and write a line or caption for each one.
Flip through it, download a PDF or share it with your family.
storybooks.tip: A storybook needs at least 2 pages to be finished.

missions.intro: Complete missions to level up, earn Ruby and see your Arena rank.
steps: Each level has 3 missions, like finishing a picture, logging in several days or trying a new theme.
You get Ruby right away for each mission you complete.
Finish all 3 to reach the next level with new missions.
Spend Ruby on brush skins and frames in the Shop.
missions.tip: Win in the Arena to rank up. Rank points never go down.
